list.name: Changes
list.comment: Expand support to monitor Telegram channels alongside groups: - Refactor logic to differentiate between groups and channels. - Update notification structure and user-facing text accordingly. - Extend tests to validate channel-specific behavior. - Adjust documentation to reflect changes.

task.summary: Add initial implementation with PostgreSQL models, bot application, and README.
Implement notification system, live message monitoring, background scanning, and recovery handling
Support individual topic tracking for Telegram groups, add multi-user management, and Docker deployment
Add unit tests for public router invite logic and integrate invite request handlers
Add tests for user access notifications and update admin user management logic
Introduce rule-based keyword matching with AND/OR logic, extend keyword schema, add migration, and update related tests and documentation
Add feedback support with admin forwarding, inline approval for access requests, and enhance user listing commands
Add access mode switching, analytics reporting, and enhanced user onboarding logic
Handle additional Telegram Bot API error types for notifications, improve recovery scheduling, and enhance repository structure and tests
Add bot pause functionality with PostgreSQL persistence, admin commands, middleware support, and tests
Handle group unavailability by introducing `ScanGroupUnavailable` exception, resolving groups from dialogs after session restarts, and adding corresponding unit tests.
Add command menu configuration with user and admin scopes, integrate shared command catalog into help and onboarding, and include corresponding tests and documentation updates

Expand support to monitor Telegram channels alongside groups: - Refactor logic to differentiate between groups and channels. - Update notification structure and user-facing text accordingly. - Extend tests to validate channel-specific behavior. - Adjust documentation to reflect changes.
